nodes.text: If $\omega(n)$ counts the number of distinct prime divisors of $n$ then let\[F(n)=\max_k \omega(n+k)\frac{\log\log k}{\log k}.\]Prove that $F(n)\to \infty$ as $n\to \infty$.

#1203 : [Er80,p.107] number theory It is easy to prove that $F(n)\geq 1-o(1)$.
